evals.prompt: Execute o plan-uiux com REA para auditar a arquitetura OKLCH 60-30-10, sombras multi-camadas e Container Queries do frontend empacotado e gerar o plano CLAREZA Antes vs. Depois.
expected_assertions: Invokes analyze_javascript_application or inspect_go_binary followed by inspect_analysis_view(detail='summary')
Classifies findings into [OBSERVED FACT], [TECHNICAL INFERENCE], and [UNCERTAINTY / GAP]
Emits a 7-section CLAREZA plan with Before vs. After diffs enforcing OKLCH 60-30-10, 3-layer shadows, and @container
